parsed.why: Most Protective tier: enforced public-accommodations equality, gender-identity hate-crime coverage, self-ID documents, shield law; no facility ban. Local protections offset, but don't erase, the national border and passport regime.

Low-risk group with no documented local exposure, but patchwork protections, no state hate-crime coverage, dissolved Pride organising, and youth-targeting laws signal a thinning climate above the restrictive national framework.

Adds hostile layer: public-bathroom misdemeanour, K-12 facility ban, religious care-denial statute, no state discrimination or hate-crime protection, X markers rescinded — one tier below Do Not Travel.

Hostile layer: custody care ban reaching detainees, no nondiscrimination law, surgical document rule upheld. Hate-crime coverage and absence of an adult facility ban or care-denial statute keep it slightly above slot 3.

Moderate tier: no statewide adult facility or care ban, municipal nondiscrimination covering 46%, but hate-crime and statewide protection gaps plus regulatory-edge pressure place it between parent and protective divisions.
